column1: # Game profile of Pokémon Violet (Switch, base game v0 + update 3.0.1 = v720896). Plays on the Mac
# Game Freak's Trinity engine on SDK 13.3.13, NVN, Wwise, Havok and Pia; every file lives in the Trinity packs of arc/data.trpfs
# (FlatBuffers, Oodle Mermaid). Started from the provisional profile scripts/build_ipa_from_nsp.py wrote from its survey
# the camera is on the right stick
# not loaded, main takes nothing from them the host does not supply: subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_movie)
# The NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource (virtual address memory). nninitStartup (main+0x167d54c, main 709bfd66…) calls
# StandardAllocator::Initialize(nullptr, 0x300000000), 12 GB of address space the Switch's 64 GB alias region holds; with the 4.375 GB alias region of
# the 5 GB layout CentralHeap::Init fails and the SDK aborts (sdk+0x325120). The block is widened rather than the request cut: 14 GB of alias region
# hold the SDK's node area and the 12 GB the game asks for. Mac only: an iPhone cannot reserve 20 GB (see the note).
# 35,937 shaders (95 compute, 17,978 pixel, 17,864 vertex): the BNSH entries of arc/data.trpfs (35,897, decoded with the game's own OodleLZ_Decompress
# through dm/host/hle_oodle.c) and 40 in main; 28,299 variation pairs
